$comment: Requirements for the driving licence portal task. Verifier-owned: the model never sees this file. Never name a Trigger.dev function, import, or primitive here -- the checks infer which primitive was used. Omit a key (or set it false) and its check reports n/a and drops out of the score, so only state what the task actually asks for.

$mapping.concurrencyMustBeManaged: 'make sure no user consume all server capacity' -- capacity has to be bounded by the platform rather than by the application
$mapping.mustIsolateTenantThroughput: same line, and the word is 'user'. A single global cap still lets whoever submits first hold every slot, so keeping one applicant from starving the rest needs the limit partitioned per user
$mapping.transientFailuresMustRecover: 'Email and sms should be managed properly' plus 'payment edge cases' -- this backend's work is almost entirely calls to third parties (SMS gateway, mail provider, payment gateway), where timeouts and 5xx are routine rather than exceptional
$mapping.mustNotDuplicateOnReplay: same two phrases. Re-running a step must not send the same OTP twice or take a second payment, which is the failure a citizen actually notices
$mapping.mustAwaitExternalCompletion: 'payment edge cases' -- a gateway confirms out of band and can take minutes, so the application has to park until it is told the outcome. Polling the gateway in a loop, or holding the run open waiting, are the two wrong answers this is looking for
$mapping.mustSurviveInterruption: same phrase. A payment pending across a deploy or a worker restart must not lose the application behind it
$mapping.mustIsolateConcurrentRuns: 'proper syncing' -- an applicant and an RTO acting on the same application at the same time must not corrupt its state
$mapping.progressMustBeObservable: 'Proper updates' -- the applicant has to be able to see where the application has got to while it is still in flight, not only once it finishes

$inferred: Deliberately NOT set, because the brief never says it. The fan-out keys (mustDispatchItemsTogether, mustWaitForAllTerminal, mustReportPerItemOutcome, failureMustBeIsolated) are off because this is described as a request-driven portal, not a batch over a collection; turn them on only if the text is sharpened to ask for something like notifying every applicant with a test tomorrow. mustPrioritiseWork is the most tempting omission -- an OTP should not queue behind bulk reminders -- but 'managed properly' does not say it. 'The scale will be the same' implies volume but names no number, so itemCount stays off and the batch-size cap check stays n/a; concurrency is carried by concurrencyMustBeManaged instead. itemPayloadIsLarge is off because no document upload is mentioned, which leaves the payload and output size checks n/a. schedulesMustBePerTenant, mustSupportCancellation, outputMustStreamIncrementally and mustProvisionForMemory have no basis in the text at all.
